        if tft_match >= n - 3:

            else:

                responses_def += 1
            else:
                responses_coop += 1
    total_responses = responses_def + responses_coop
    retaliation_rate = responses_def / total_responses if total_responses > 0 else 0.5
    base_defect_rate = opp_def / n if n > 0 else 0.0

    retaliatory = False
    if total_responses > 0:
